BEFORE YOU DIVE IN

A few good
questions.

Ask us on GitHub
Can I use Rayden in a commercial project?

Yes. Rayden is open source and MIT licensed. Use it in personal or commercial projects, following the license terms.

What do I need to get started?

A React project with Tailwind CSS v4. Install @raydenui/ui and follow the setup guide, or use create-rayden-app to start a new Vite or Next.js project.

Can I make it match my brand?

Yes. Customize shared design tokens and style components with Tailwind. Colors, typography, spacing, and component variants give you room to build your own visual language.

How does the AI companion work?

@raydenui/ai provides an MCP server with structured information about Rayden components, tokens, and recipes. Connect it to a compatible coding assistant using the AI integration guide.
